void.rationale: VoidInd maps directly to the VOID checkbox at the top of the W-2G form.

corrected.rationale: CorrectedW2GInd maps directly to the CORRECTED checkbox at the top of the form.

payer_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under PayerName/BusinessNameLine1Txt is the primary payer name line.

payer_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles street address into one string but canonical schema splits into PayerUSAddress/AddressLine1Txt (idx 22) and PayerForeignAddress/AddressLine1Txt (idx 13); blueprint should be split into separate fields for US vs. foreign address line 1.

payer_room_suite.rationale: Blueprint has a separate room/suite field but canonical schema represents this as AddressLine2Txt (idx 23 for US, idx 14 for foreign); blueprint should map this to AddressLine2Txt rather than a distinct field.

payer_city.rationale: No CityNm element exists under PayerUSAddress or PayerForeignAddress in the canonical candidate list; the schema likely embeds city in the address group but it is not exposed as a discrete candidate here.

payer_state.rationale: No StateAbbreviationCd or ProvinceOrStateNm element exists under PayerUSAddress or PayerForeignAddress in the candidate list; cannot match without the correct xpath candidate.

payer_country.rationale: CountryCd under PayerForeignAddress/CountryCd is the canonical field for the payer's country.

payer_zip.rationale: No ZIPCd or ForeignPostalCd element appears under PayerUSAddress or PayerForeignAddress in the candidate list; cannot match without the correct xpath candidate.

payer_tin.rationale: PayerEIN directly corresponds to the PAYER'S TIN box on the W-2G form.

payer_phone.rationale: PayerTelephoneNum maps directly to the PAYER'S telephone no. field.

winner_name.rationale: RecipientNm maps directly to the WINNER'S name box on the form.

winner_address.rationale: AddressLine1Txt under RecipientUSAddress is the best match for the winner's street address, assuming a US address.

winner_apt_no.rationale: AddressLine2Txt under RecipientUSAddress is the canonical field for apartment/suite number in the recipient's US address.

winner_city.rationale: CityNm exists only under RecipientForeignAddress in the candidate list; no CityNm under RecipientUSAddress is available, so this only partially matches for foreign addresses.

winner_state.rationale: ProvinceOrStateNm exists only under RecipientForeignAddress; no StateAbbreviationCd under RecipientUSAddress is available in the candidate list, so this is only a partial foreign-address match.

winner_country.rationale: CountryCd under RecipientForeignAddress/CountryCd is the canonical field for the winner's country.

winner_zip.rationale: ForeignPostalCd under RecipientForeignAddress is the only postal code candidate for the recipient; no ZIPCd under RecipientUSAddress appears in the candidate list, so this only matches foreign addresses.

winner_tin.rationale: RecipientSSN maps to Box 9 WINNER'S TIN; the schema uses SSN as the primary identifier for the recipient.

box1_reportable_winnings.rationale: GamblingReportableWinningAmt maps directly to Box 1 Reportable winnings.

box2_date_won.rationale: GamblingWinningDt maps directly to Box 2 Date won.

box3_type_of_wager.rationale: GamblingWinWagerTypeDesc maps directly to Box 3 Type of wager.

box4_federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt maps directly to Box 4 Federal income tax withheld.

box5_transaction.rationale: GamblingWinningTransactionDesc maps directly to Box 5 Transaction identifier.

box6_race.rationale: GamblingWinningEventDesc is the best available match for Box 6 Race, describing the specific race or event.

box7_winnings_from_identical_wagers.rationale: GamblingWinFromIdntclWagersAmt maps directly to Box 7 Winnings from identical wagers.

box8_cashier.rationale: GamblingWinCashierId maps directly to Box 8 Cashier.

box10_window.rationale: GamblingWinWindowNum maps directly to Box 10 Window.

box11_first_id.rationale: RecipientFirstAdditionalIdNum maps directly to Box 11 First identification no.

box12_second_id.rationale: RecipientSecondAdditionalIdNum maps directly to Box 12 Second identification no.

box13_state_payer_id.rationale: PayerStateIdNum under W2GStateLocalTaxGrp maps directly to Box 13 State/Payer's state identification no.

box14_state_winnings.rationale: GamblingWinningAmt under W2GStateLocalTaxGrp maps directly to Box 14 State winnings.

box15_state_income_tax_withheld.rationale: StateTaxWithheldAmt under W2GStateLocalTaxGrp maps directly to Box 15 State income tax withheld.

box16_local_winnings.rationale: GamblingWinningAmt under W2GStateLocalTaxGrp/W2GLocalTaxGrp maps directly to Box 16 Local winnings.

box17_local_income_tax_withheld.rationale: LocalIncomeTaxAmt under W2GStateLocalTaxGrp/W2GLocalTaxGrp maps directly to Box 17 Local income tax withheld.

box18_name_of_locality.rationale: LocalityNm under W2GStateLocalTaxGrp/W2GLocalTaxGrp maps directly to Box 18 Name of locality.

tax_year.rationale: CalendarYr maps directly to the tax year printed in the form heading.
